record.what_it_does: Cloud customer support helpdesk and ticketing platform from Freshworks.
record.auth_notes: The REST API uses each agent's personal API key, sent as HTTP Basic auth (key as username, any placeholder as password, Base64-encoded). Endpoints carry 'OAuth 2.0 Scope' labels, but there is no third-party OAuth flow for Freshdesk. On the Freshworks developer forum, a Freshworks responder said in March 2025 that OAuth shipped only for Freshchat and is 'not planned yet' for Freshdesk. The official MCP endpoint also takes an API key only. A multi-user toolkit needs each user's API key plus their account subdomain.
record.access_notes: The API docs are public, and any account, trials included, can generate an API key. The 14-day trial gives Enterprise-level access with a 50 calls/min API limit. The current pricing page lists only paid plans: Growth $19, Pro $55 and Enterprise $89 per agent per month, billed annually. It shows no free plan. Freshdesk's own help article says the old free Sprout plan had no API access. So ongoing API use needs a paid plan, and outside the trial a developer cannot get keys for free. Some features are gated by plan: the Trigger API automation action needs Pro or above, and the sandbox is Enterprise-only.
record.api_breadth_notes: The docs cover tickets (including watchers, merge, archive, summaries and user access), ticket fields and forms, conversations, outbound messages, contacts, contact fields, agents, service accounts, skills, roles, groups, companies, custom objects, canned responses, discussions, solutions, CSAT surveys, field service, time entries, email configs and mailboxes, products, business hours, scenario automations, SLA policies, automations, settings, threads and the audit log. That is well over 50 operations.
record.mcp_notes: Freshworks hosts an official MCP server at https://<subdomain>.freshdesk.com/mcp. It became generally available on September 10, 2026, authenticates with an API key only and does not work on custom domains. It is available on the Growth (25 actions/min, 1,200 actions/yr), Pro (50/min, 6,000/yr) and Enterprise (100/min, 12,000/yr) plans. It offers 37 tools covering tickets, conversations, contacts, agents, groups, companies and solutions. Community and commercial alternatives: effytech/freshdesk_mcp, Enreign/freshdeck-mcp, Workato and CData.
record.blocker_notes: The REST API is public and broad, with per-user API keys. Caveats: there is no OAuth, so users must paste a key and subdomain. There is no free tier with API access; the 14-day trial works for development, but lasting test access needs a paid plan. Rate limits are per account and depend on the plan. The sandbox is Enterprise-only. Webhooks can only be set up by an admin inside automation rules; there is no API to subscribe to them.
